usageNotes: Returns a cluster-wide index of all QEMU VM entries across all nodes; useful as a quick inventory check without targeting a specific node. No parameters are required and any authenticated user may call it, but results reflect only VMs visible to the caller's permission set. Does not include LXC containers — use the equivalent cluster/lxc endpoint for those.

examples.summary: List all QEMU VMs across the cluster

tips: Returns VM metadata (name, VMID, node, status) but not full config details — follow up with get_nodes_node_qemu_vmid_config per VM for config specifics.
Useful for finding which node a given VMID lives on before issuing node-scoped operations.
Returned list is an array of child link objects; the 'name' field corresponds to the VMID.
